name: Lethlor Ravine
summary: Black dragons roost and rear their young in Lethlor Ravine, deep in the eastern Badlands.

sections.title: A Dragonflight's Bastion
sections.body: Scorched plateaus rise around Lethlor Ravine in the eastern Badlands. Craggy walls shelter the black dragonflight’s nests. Fierce whelps crowd beneath the watch of larger drakes that breathe fire. Few travelers dare approach the ravine floor. Overhead, shadows mark winged predators circling among the rocky spires.

sections.title: Mysteries in the Dust
sections.body: Crystalline obelisks lie scattered among the crags beside the dragon brood. They are involved in a local chain of tasks, but their origin is not established.

faq.answer: Lethlor Ravine cuts through the eastern Badlands, where black dragons nest among craggy walls.

faq.q: Why are there so many black dragons here?
aliases: why are there dragons in badlands
faq.answer: The black dragonflight roosts and rears its young among Lethlor Ravine’s sheltered, desolate rock formations, far from major civilized cities.

faq.q: What are the crystal obelisks in the ravine?
faq.answer: Crystalline obelisks lie scattered through the ravine and are involved in a local chain of tasks. Their origin is not established.

faq.q: Is Lethlor Ravine safe for travelers?
aliases: can i walk through lethlor ravine
faq.answer: No. Flying drakes and aggressive whelps fill the ravine and attack trespassers on sight.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can test your marksmanship against fast-moving dragonkin and winged predators among Lethlor Ravine’s ridges and skies.
